messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['Barclays Bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Barclays Security software.', 'We were unable to process your most recent payment.', 'The Republic of South Africa has approved Tender for the building of 570Housing units at ACE province in INDONESIA.', 'A money transfer has just been sent to ...', 'This is your official notification that the service(s) listed below will be deactivated and deleted if not renew immediately.', 'We received a request at 7.30PM Yesterday to delete your email box permanently.', 'A DGTFX virus has been detected in your folders', 'We recently have determined that different computers have logged onto your Discover Bank online account, and multiple password failures were present before the logons.', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', "We received your request to shut down your mailbox, kindly cancel request if it's an error to continue using our services:- CANCEL REQUEST & RECTIFY THIS PROBLEM", 'We reviewed your account, and suspected that your co-operative bank Account, may have been violated from another IP.', 'We recently reviewed your account, and we are suspecting that your Internet Banking account may have been accessed from an unauthorized computer.', 'Hence, we have closed down your account for safety and security measures as we think someone has tried unauthorized access to your account.', 'Ocean Bank would like to inform about security updates', 'You have 1 new Security Message Alert!', 'I am writing to let you know that the Cornell University Grant Act grant has been increased for you.', 'You have received this email because you or someone had used your account from different locations.', 'We recently have determined that different computers have logged onto your Online Banking account, and multiple password failures were present before the logons.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
